notes.title: Patch Notes 1.13 - More Randomizer Options
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes 1.13[/h1]

[h3]New Randomizer Options[/h3]

With this patch we are adding 3 highly requested randomizer options that you can opt into when starting a new campaign, which are as follows:

[list]
[*] Random Passives: When promoting or class changing, units will receive a random passive in the slot for that class tier
[*] Random Abilities: When promoting or class changing, units will receive a random ability in the slot for that class tier
[*] Random Loot: When killing an enemy with loot or looting a chest, that loot will be randomized
[/list]

I think these are our most fun randomizer additions yet, can't wait to see what goofy things happen in your campaigns with these now available! I am a big fan personally of random loot in particular, as it really changes the meta progression in significant ways.

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Significantly improved performance optimization in base and premap, particularly for lower end devices
[*] Significantly improved performance optimization in general gameplay, particularly for lower end devices
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a variety of issues with unit interaction
[*] Fixed an issue where the rings menu was incorrectly displaying multiple rings in the same slot
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.11
notes.content:
[h3]Patch Notes 1.11[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where battlesaving and loading in certain circumstances could lead to not getting the proper post level scene
[*] Fixed a crash where giving inputs to both attack and cancel action could crash the game under certain circumstances
[*] Fixed an issue where clicking through levelup screens could alter the fast forward functionality as well
[*] Fixed an issue with the titan rune decreasing accuracy by the wrong amount
[*] Fixed an issue where celerity was not applying its power reduction
[*] Fixed an issue with the vicious rune having slightly incorrect value reductions
[*] Fixed an issue where divine flow was decrementing stacks for ALL units with the ability active
[*] Fixed a potential crash with the game trying to draw non existent enemies to the screen
[*] Fixed an issue where casting an ability that brought you back to the action menu could default to the wrong menu slot and make it easy to accidentally end turn instead of acting
[*] Fixed an issue with the hurricane ring not applying its effects when equipped in prebattle
[*] Changed one of the upgrades for 'Bloodstroke' so that it doesn't have 3 of the same option
[/list]


There are some issues right now with post-battle damage effects like bleed and 'wreathed in flame', as well as when both units in the combat die due to either those effects or 'repulsor shield'. Particularly this can bypass the death scripts and cause some unintended functionality like the resurrection ability failing to target that unit or not receiving a wound/ending the level on Demonic difficulty. If you run into one of these things - I am working on getting it fixed but want to be careful around pushing changes for it to the live build since there are so many different ways that these scripts interact. When I've had time to properly test it and make sure all is well I'll have a fix out for it soon!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.09 - Some Small New Features
notes.content:
[h3]Patch Notes 1.09[/h3]

Took a small ~1 day hiatus from bug fixing to add some of the most highly requested features, and will be returning so fixing things up now! Hope you have fun with the new additions!

[h3]New Options[/h3]

[list]
[*] There is now a toggleable option to make it so your levelups don't auto advance. Stare at them as long as you like!
[*] There is now a toggleable option to make it so fast forward is automatically on. It is still changeable with a click, but for any case where fast forward is appropriate, it will begin on with this option toggled.
[/list]

[h3]New Campaign Customizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shuffled Unit Aptitudes: This randomly adjusts each individual unit's aptitudes, swapping them around randomly.
[*] Shuffled Unit Passives: This creates a pool of all 20 unit passives and assigns them at random to the team.
[*] Shuffled Unit Personals: This creates a pool of all 20 unit personal active abilities and assigns them at random to the team.
[/list]

Keep in mind that these new campaign customization options are fairly experimental, so you may run into untested interactions with them. I'll be sure to get anything serious with the mode patched up ASAP if it pops up, just make sure to report it in the Steam forums or our discord!

notes.title: Thank you for great launch | Patch Notes 1.05
notes.content:
It's day 4 now of Dark Deity 2  being out, and I just want to take a second to say a huge thank you to everyone playing the game! 

It’s been a blast hearing about the story choices you’re making, the unit builds you're experimenting with, and the team comps you're theorycrafting. Your feedback, bug reports, and support have been making a big impact. It’s also been so rewarding to see the game hit New & Trending on Steam and already pass 260 reviews. Thank you for helping make that happen!

I just pushed Patch 1.05 (my fifth patch in four days) as I’ve been hard at work to stay on top of your reports. I am doing my best to get through everything and you've all been immensely helpful already. I’m prioritizing the highest-impact bugs (like crashes and freezes) first, then I’ll be diving deeper into more general feedback. Please keep the reports coming; every message helps, and I’m doing what I can to make sure I read through every report and piece of feedback. 

If you want to see the previous patch notes, you can find them by checking out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2446600]The Steam News Hub for the Game here[/url]!


[b] The 1.05 patch notes for this evening are as follows:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue on Steam Deck where the internal pointer could get stuck on the codex button and stop base menus from properly functioning
[*] Fixed a crash with AOE abilities in certain map circumstances
[*] Fixed a crash in certain later game prebattles when switching between menus
[*] Added in a failsafe for possible freezing on critical hits on some systems, should solve any edge cases remaining
[*] Fixed an issue where call the storm was leaving a 0.00 decimal reading into the level stats
[*] Fixed an issue where the text for skipping cutscenes was not properly dropping down on some resolutions
[*] Fixed an issue where you could crash the game by trying to sell an empty weapon slot
[*] Fixed an issue where you could buy bugged weapons by buying an empty weapon slot
[/list]

Once again, thank you all so much for the love and support. It truly means the world to me, and seeing the response so far has been amazing. If you’re enjoying your time with Dark Deity 2, please consider leaving a review on Steam. Early reviews are hugely helpful for indie games and it’s been awesome reading through your thoughts so far.

If you’ve got feedback or run into any issues, hop into the [url=https://discord.gg/68ca8u2]Discord[/url] or drop a post in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2446600/discussions/0/828205063834975147/]Steam Discussion Bug Report Thread[/url]. More updates are on the way!

notes.title: Happy Holidays & Demo News from the Devs
notes.content:
With 2025 fast approaching, I wanted to take a second to thank everyone for the support you've shown us this year. Making a video game can be exhausting at times and a big part of what keeps us going is knowing that so many of you are excited for DD2. We are hurtling towards a final build at what feels like 1000 miles an hour, and I am really thrilled to get you all playing the full game soon.

[b]We'll be taking the demo down on January 2nd[/b] so we can spend some time taking in remaining feedback and maybe getting a new demo build with the dizzying list of fixes I've already made thanks to your help. I cannot stress enough how fantastic this demo round was for the state of DD2. Thankfully it was pretty stable, so I've had a ton of time to track down all those funky little bugs or functionality fixes and improvements that folks have been hoping for. A little peek at a couple of the more requested and high profile pieces:


[list]
[*] All map art in the game now has shadows, drastically improving map feel.
[*] Pretty much every menu now has hover tooltips that explain debuffs or stats. No more checking the codex to see what Heavy Bleed does - if you hover an ability/passive/item that applies it, it will tell you.
[*] Complete redesign of Chapter 3! This one had been on the docket for a while, but we have completely redesigned the chapter to play better across the board.
[*] Interactable tiles (seize, evacuate, etc) now have a tooltip that tells you their function when hovered.
[*] Character art now shows in the expanded unit view screen during gameplay
[*] The infinite staircase in the very first scene has been removed and replaced with a better scene. I will miss it deeply, as it had been in the game in some capacity for a year and a half or so.
[/list]

There are a couple hundred more small changes I could talk about, but I'll keep it to the essentials for now. For the remaining 10 days that the demo is live, remember that there are campaign customization options and the demo is built to be replayed with new classes! In the full release you won't be getting into the tier 2 classes quite so rapidly, so if you're the type of person that likes to plan out their builds this is a great opportunity to do so.

Also, if you haven't joined yet, the official [url=https://discord.gg/jPeyv7f]discord[/url] is a great place to chat about the game and share your feedback, thoughts, and builds!

Happy holidays everyone, and thank you again. I feel like I say this constantly, but your support means the world to myself and the rest of the team. We're gonna keep working hard to make DD2 as good as can be!

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes, December 10th 2024
notes.content:
Here are the first patch notes for the DD2 demo! We've got a long way to go before the game is fully where we want it, but I wanted to act on some of the higher priority stuff quickly for y'all while the demo is live. 

Also, quick reminder that campaign customization is already live, meaning if you want to tackle the demo chapters with exceptional difficulty or tweak things for a new run you can do so. The sandbox is built to reward creative play, so levels can be tackled at extremely high difficulties with the right team compositions!

[h3]Content[/h3]

[list]
[*] Included 2 additional story scenes from the start of Chapter 5
[/list]

[h3]Features[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added a codex that explains stats and effects (planning to expand tooltips in the future as well)
[*] Added the option to disable turn limits for maps that don't have a turn-based victory when starting a playthrough
[*] Added the option to select rolled or linear stat leveling when starting a new playthrough (RNG vs. Set)
[*] Added a hover-over display for shop items and weapons that displays stats or purpose
[*] Added ability ranges to several menus
[*] Enemies that have their range showing now glow purple
[*] Added a button to open/close all enemy ranges (Y on PC, Select/Back on controller. Also in the context menu)
[*] The Devoted class now uses Axes
[*] Weapon type is now displayed on the Class Tree menu
[*] Class attack range is now displayed on the Class Tree menu
[*] Added additional indication for when rune storage is empty
[*] Clicking a player unit with no actions left opens their unit information page
[*] Moved several objectives in Chapter 2 and made the boss more clear
[/list]


[h3]Bug/Functionality[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with equipping rings when only 1 ring is in storage
[*] Fixed some issues with UI clipping with eachother and off the map (some more work to be done here)
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed runes to be slotted without having a rune to slot
[*] Fixed an issue with shop icons showing up wrong
[*] Fixed a crash in chapter 4 when picking certain routes
[*] Fixed a variety of visual glitches
[*] Fixed an issue with selecting a unit in the elixirs menu also attempting to apply the elixir immediately
[*] Fixed a crash in the base menu when toggling between controller and mouse controls in certain contexts
[*] Fixed an issue with weapons and resources persisting through starting a new game without resetting game (certain things may still be replicated here, still working through making sure everything possible gets reset)
[*] Fixed an issue with Saxon’s Call the Storm not targeting correctly, also buffed the ability
[/list]

Planning to act on many more pieces of feedback and bugs that have been reported, but trying to get to some of the higher priority stuff first, thank you all again for taking the time to play the demo!
